title: FlowFix Document Pre-Check Output
description: Schema for the document-precheck flow output. Consumer (backend or Bob) must validate the LLM output against this schema before using the result. A structurally valid JSON does not guarantee factual correctness — human review is still required for authenticity and administrative decisions.

status.description: PASS: no issues found from available evidence. NEEDS_FIX: issues the student can correct. NEEDS_HUMAN_CHECK: unreadable document, missing input, or ambiguous issue.

field.description: The form field or document field affected, or null.

document.description: The filename of the document where the issue was found, or null.

message.description: Clear description of the issue found.

evidence.description: Quoted text from the relevant document(s), or null. For mismatches, should cite both sides.

summary.description: One-sentence summary of the overall pre-check result.
